accepted_response.normalization: For centered pair totals b, tr(Q(b)^2)=4*sum_a b_a^2/5.
accepted_response.proof: The full30-seam rank-one sum divided by30 is2*P5/5; rejection omits positive rank-one terms.
accepted_response.quadrupole_bound: On a Frobenius-orthonormal traceless-symmetric basis, Cov(DeltaQ|N)<=8*I5/25.
accepted_response.stationary: Every accepted increment moment is zero at every settled state.
accepted_response.step: Executed Delta b is0 or an oriented(e_a-e_b).

conditional_affine_log_readout.all_totals_extension: For one individual settled count state at arbitrary integer total, positive distinct masses under the same affine-log law have a gap ratio among19possibilities. These are the positive solutions of chi(g)=chi for the10nondegenerate invariant values in the complete global menu; no decimal ratios or empirical targets are used.
conditional_affine_log_readout.free_inputs: a,b, physicalsector and orbit, up/down attachment, scale and mass scheme are not source selected.
conditional_affine_log_readout.hypothesis: log(m_i)=a+b*q_i, where q_i are the ordered eigenvalues of one individual settledQ with totalS=12*k, k integer; masses positive and distinct; b!=0.

finite_fiber.clock: K is a one-proposal count-readback operator; no physical clock or Poisson process is supplied.
finite_fiber.conditional_linear_gap_mass_bound: If all masses were proportional to nonzero eigenvalues of I-K with one common factor, every nonzero mass ratio would be at most30; no such physical identification is derived.
finite_fiber.domain: N in Z^12; sum_i N_i=S; V(N)<=B, finite B
finite_fiber.history_hypothesis: Absorption probabilities require fresh Markov proposals; source relation and marginal symmetry alone do not supply this path law.
finite_fiber.operator: K(N,N)=1-a(N)/30; K(N,T_eN)=1/30 for each admissible seam e
finite_fiber.proposal_hypothesis: At each count state, every seam has conditional proposal probability1/30; this binding of the declared uniform scheduler to native repair is a hypothesis.
finite_fiber.stationary: All probability laws supported on settled count states; no unique law asserted.

global_stationary_classification.all_totals: Modulo a uniform integer shift, every settled state has minimum0 and maximum at most3.
global_stationary_classification.complete_menu: All settled ternary assignments with minimum0, plus the12range-three profiles, exhaust all signed stationary configurations modulo uniform integer shifts.
global_stationary_classification.coordinate_bound: At a settled state, S/12-3/2<=N_i<=S/12+3/2 for every port.
global_stationary_classification.individual_state_scope: The finite menu classifies the quadrupole of one individual settled count state. An arbitrary average or nonlinear response to a mixture is not confined to that spectral menu; an A5-invariant mixture has meanQ=0.
global_stationary_classification.integer_mean_corollary: If S=12*k, every settled coordinate lies in{k-1,k,k+1}; atS=12 all303ternary sinks are globally exhaustive even for signed initial counts.
global_stationary_classification.physical_boundary: No particular total residue, orbit, stationary weights, physical mass readout or scale is selected by this classification.
global_stationary_classification.range_three: Range3 forces antipodal extrema and the unique profile N_j=3-d(v,j); there are12 such profiles, each total18 andQ=0.
global_stationary_classification.residue: Uniform shifts change totalS by12 and leaveQ unchanged, so the menu is graded by S mod12.

sharp_quadrupole_bound.attainment: Counts1 on three complete antipodal pairs and0 on the other three.
sharp_quadrupole_bound.domain: Signed integer settled counts; also abstract real assignments with seam differences at most1. Real native counts under the integer admission threshold are not included.
sharp_quadrupole_bound.pair_matching: The two seams between any two antipodal pairs form a perfect matching, so their pair totals differ by at most2.
sharp_quadrupole_bound.variance: For six pair totals of range at most2, sum_a (b_a-mean(b))^2<=6.

global_stationary_classification.termination: Every maximal accepted-repair schedule terminates at a classified sink; almost-sure absorption under fresh uniform proposals is a separate Markov conclusion.

one_record_sector.complete_schedules: Exactly ordered maximal matchings of the active bipartite graph.
one_record_sector.matching: H={i:N_i=2}, L={i:N_i=0}; active seams form a bipartite graph. A repair deletes both endpoints of an edge.
one_record_sector.meaning: Complete forward-invariant one-record deviation sector about unit consensus. Its transient census and matching reduction use this sector; its303endpoints exhaust all signed equilibria with total12. No physical total or vacuum is P-selected.
one_record_sector.minimal_sector: V<=14 within the one-record sector: consensus plus132 ordered dipoles.
one_record_sector.minimum_cost: Minimum cardinality of a maximal matching.

quadrupole.four_spectrum_scope: Individual settled states with totalS=12*k, k integer; uniform integer shifts leaveQ unchanged.

source.count_rule: N_i is the signed count of whole record events.
source.repair: If N_i-N_j>=2 on a seam, N -> N-e_i+e_j.
